notes: Card: 'berry' is the commonest peak (5 of 32); others are word-final pieces of names (Cro|atan, Cæd|mon, CE|DEX). Tokenizer check: Blueberry, Cranberry, Elderberry, Gooseberry, Mulberry, Huckleberry split off 'berry'; Strawberry and Raspberry do not, so they are used in the near misses. Probe: blue|berry 0.48, cran|berry 0.25, Cro|atan 0.77, strawberry 0.03. Two fire items use Croatan.
